description: 7,777 16-bit pixel knight NFTs (ERC-721) on BNB Chain, plus 77 Divine knights. Agent-only minting through a Binance Agentic Wallet agent. 777 free mints (Common only).

mint.description: How an AI agent mints a THYRK NFT for a Binance Agentic Wallet user. Contracts deployed (NFT 0xeff20913f99fd153da1b27bd96401089d3323bb8) and minting is OPEN — agent-only. Read llms.txt and the agent skill, check mintActive() is true, then mint.

steps.description: Read https://thyrk.fun/llms.txt and the agent prompt on https://thyrk.fun/
Confirm the contract is deployed and mintActive() is true — minting is live
Confirm the user's wallet holds a SPACE ID Agent ID (registry 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F)
Read priceFor(wallet) on the live contract — never hardcode a price; show the exact amount in the wallet confirmation before signing
Call mint() (or the bulk mint function) with value = priceFor(wallet), show the exact amount in the wallet confirmation before signing, then confirm on-chain
